api_contracts.item: request body {sku: string (required, trimmed, non-empty), location: string (required, trimmed, non-empty), EXACTLY ONE of quantity: integer >= 0 (set-to-value mode, S1) OR delta: non-zero signed integer (adjust-by-delta mode, S2-adjust-by-delta; the service computes new_quantity = prior_quantity + delta against the row-locked current quantity), actor: string (required, trimmed, non-empty)}; response 201 is the written StockAdjustment {id: integer, sku: string, location: string, prior_quantity: integer, new_quantity: integer, actor: string, adjusted_at: string (ISO-8601 UTC, server-stamped), delta: integer (derived new_quantity - prior_quantity, never stored separately)}. The stock_records quantity update and the audit insert commit in ONE transaction. Validation failure is 422 {detail: [{field: 'sku'|'location'|'quantity'|'delta'|'actor', message: string}]} naming the offending field; nothing changes, no audit row. Negative-stock guard (S3-reject-negative-stock): a negative quantity is 422 field 'quantity'; a delta whose prior + delta < 0 (evaluated by the service against the row-locked current quantity) is 422 field 'delta', message 'quantity would go below zero'; a resulting quantity of exactly 0 is accepted (201). 404 {detail: string} when no stock record exists for the (sku, location) pair (an adjustment never creates a record).

bare JSON array of StockAdjustment {id: integer, sku: string, location: string, prior_quantity: integer, new_quantity: integer, actor: string, adjusted_at: string (ISO-8601 UTC), delta: integer (derived new_quantity - prior_quantity)} for the (sku, location) pair, newest first (adjusted_at desc, id desc); [] when none. Read-only: no PUT/PATCH/DELETE route exists on /api/adjustments or /api/adjustments/{id} (a mutation attempt is 405).

persistence_invariants.brief: stock_adjustments.sku, location, prior_quantity, new_quantity, actor and adjusted_at are all NOT NULL (adjusted_at server-defaulted to now()); an insert missing any is rejected by the DB.
A CHECK (length(btrim(actor)) > 0) rejects an empty or whitespace-only actor at the DB level, even when the service is bypassed.
A CHECK (new_quantity >= 0 AND prior_quantity >= 0) rejects a negative quantity in an audit row at the DB level.

A composite FOREIGN KEY (sku, location) REFERENCES stock_records (sku, location) ON DELETE RESTRICT: an audit row for a non-existent pair is rejected, and a stock_records row with audit history cannot be deleted out from under it.
A BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger on stock_adjustments raises, so a direct UPDATE or DELETE of an audit row on the paired branch is rejected and the row keeps its original values.

The stock_records quantity update and the stock_adjustments insert commit in one transaction: a failure of either (e.g. the audit insert violating PI9) leaves stock_records.quantity unchanged and no audit row.

Initial create_table: after downgrade to this migration's down_revision then upgrade head, stock_adjustments and its columns, CHECKs, composite FK and immutability trigger are present again (schema recreated; no row survival is claimed for the initial creation).

Additive migration on the PRE-EXISTING stock_records schema: stock_records rows present before upgrade to the create_stock_adjustments revision persist unchanged after the upgrade and after a downgrade to its down_revision.

access_patterns.brief: SELECT ... FROM stock_adjustments WHERE sku = :sku AND location = :location ORDER BY adjusted_at DESC, id DESC (EP7, the adjust-audit list); a new table with no index beyond its PK.

open_decisions.question: Where do R1's unmodifiable adjustment timestamp + actor live (deferred from F1 OD3)?
open_decisions.resolution: A dedicated append-only stock_adjustments table (FK to stock_records (sku, location)), written in the same transaction as the quantity update, with DB-level NOT NULL/CHECK on actor + adjusted_at and an UPDATE/DELETE-rejecting trigger; the API exposes no mutation route. S2-adjust-by-delta reuses the same table (prior/new quantity recorded either way). Consistent with F1: adjustments only touch existing records, never create one.

open_decisions.question: field-location (adjust) lists 'all locations holding a record for the chosen SKU, incl. qty-0': reuse EP3 (all locations) + EP2 404 -> form-error, or add a sku-scoped locations endpoint?
Is the audit delta stored as its own column or derived as new_quantity - prior_quantity?
open_decisions.resolution: Derived in the service/response (delta = new_quantity - prior_quantity) for every audit row; no schema change to stock_adjustments, so S1's PI8-PI15 stand unchanged and the delta can never disagree with prior/new.
